intent_en: Analyze the cited causes of wrongful convictions and determine which cause is most frequently cited.
narration_support: Over 70 % of DNA exonerations in the US have been shown to involve inaccurate eyewitness testimony, which highlights just how much is at stake when it comes to justice and memory.
narrative_goal: Show that eyewitness misinterpretation is the most frequently cited cause of wrongful convictions, followed by improper forensics, false confessions, and informants.
current_model_input: Analyze the cited causes of wrongful convictions and determine which cause is most frequently cited.
